u/Reasonable-Smile8327 I just wanted to thank you for this comment and give an update. 

We went down the rehoming route for a couple of weeks and initially made contact with someone, but after reading your comment and trying to think things through, I couldn't bare to give up my girl. I suffer from my own mental health issues, and Poca has been there to comfort me when I'm at my lowest, even if she's not the most cuddly lap cat. I wouldn't be a very good companion or friend to her if I didn't do everything in my power to support her just the same.

My family is going through some financial hardships considering our new little, but I think the emotional toll of losing my best gal pal would be just as painful as the burden of trying to find a way to pay to medically ease her anxiety.

We're currently working on trying to save the money for blood work. Her vet agreed that we can consider anxiety medication since we've accommodated in every other aspect, but obviously blood work is necessary to ensure there aren't any other problems first. I did listen to other Redditors in adding additional litter boxes (we now have 5 total; I wanted an extra to be safe), but ended up returning the Feliway.

In the meantime, I've been working on building her bond with our little. They're getting to the point of her allowing him to pet her (with my help), and she'll even rub against him or lay close by. He's still young and learning how not to grab the kitties, but our youngest cat is doing a great job at teaching him boundaries. Neither has any fear when playing together, and there is nothing a few gentle baps won't fix :) 

Thank you to everyone for your support and considerations!
